name: ReportCardViewer
tagline: Standards-based K-12 report cards your parents can read on a phone – and acknowledge.
description: Parent-facing report card for Power Pages, Model-driven and Canvas apps: term tabs, descriptor chips per strand, effort, teacher and principal comments, learner attributes, next steps, term comparison, attendance against target and a per-term parent acknowledgement with conference request.
features: Summary KPIs with change vs previous term
Expandable subjects with strands and teacher comments
Parent acknowledgement and conference request saved as JSON
Configurable grading scale, labels and colours
